question: What claim of instruction is made by the speaker's promise to tell the arrangement of the yoginī row to the beloved one?
premises: The speaker intends to tell something.
That something is the arrangement of the yoginī row.
The recipient is the beloved one.
inference: The speaker promises to instruct the beloved one in the arrangement of the yoginī row.
uncertainties: The details of that arrangement are not given in this verse.
